lines.speaker: marcus
lines.text: Kenji! Which is mightier — the biggest muscle, or the biggest brain?

lines.speaker: kenji
lines.text: The brain, obviously. It is the only muscle that can build a crane to lift the others.

lines.speaker: marcus
lines.text: …Marcus will allow it. But ONLY because cranes are magnificent.

lines.speaker: digger
lines.text: Oi Kenji, if your toolbox is so clever, how come it can't fetch?

lines.speaker: kenji
lines.text: Botto retrieves DATA, Digger. Data is like sticks for the mind.

lines.speaker: digger
lines.text: Yeah, but can ya bury it in the garden? Didn't think so.

lines.speaker: max
lines.text: Wait — HOW do magnets push without touching?! It's been bothering me ALL day.

lines.speaker: kenji
lines.text: An invisible field, Max-kun! We will meet them properly in the Magnet Mines one day. Patience!

lines.speaker: max
lines.text: Invisible. Pushing. Fields. This world is AMAZING.

lines.speaker: marcus
lines.text: My nonna always said: measure the flour TWICE, fight the bread NEVER.

lines.speaker: digger
lines.text: Wise lady. I fought a loaf once. Lost.

lines.speaker: max
lines.text: You LOST? To BREAD?

lines.speaker: digger
lines.text: It had a crust on it, mate. A CRUST.

lines.speaker: marcus
lines.text: HOLD! A fallen gladiator of great honour lies here! Bow your heads!

lines.speaker: max
lines.text: Marcus… that's a T-rex fossil. It's a dinosaur like me — its bones turned to stone over millions of years!

lines.speaker: marcus
lines.text: A warrior who trained so hard he became SOLID ROCK? Even more honourable!

lines.speaker: kenji
lines.text: That is… not exactly the science, but the respect is noted.

lines.speaker: digger
lines.text: Max, mate — how'd your lot ever open jam jars with those little arms?

lines.speaker: max
lines.text: We didn't need to! We had jaws that could crunch a CAR. Also there were no jam jars.

lines.speaker: digger
lines.text: No jam?! Those poor ancient beasts.

lines.speaker: kenji
lines.text: Look at these gear trains! The tolerances! The tooth profiles! I could live here.

lines.speaker: marcus
lines.text: It is very... clanky. The arena has better acoustics.

lines.speaker: kenji
lines.text: Marcus. Every clank is a tiny machine SINGING.

lines.speaker: kenji
lines.text: Feel the maths, Max-kun — a small gear driving a big one trades speed for strength!

lines.speaker: max
lines.text: So if I put a TINY gear on my tail and a HUGE one on my jaws…

lines.speaker: kenji
lines.text: …you would chomp very slowly and VERY powerfully. I will sketch it immediately.

lines.speaker: max
lines.text: Do you think Vex ever learned ANYTHING himself?

lines.speaker: kenji
lines.text: Once, perhaps. Somewhere along the way he decided answers matter more than understanding.

lines.speaker: digger
lines.text: Big mistake. Understanding's the tasty part — answers are just the bone at the end.
